The bowl looks like a metal mixing bowl, about 20 cm across at the rim. It holds roughly 15 dark olives, probably Kalamata. Each olive weighs about 4-5 g, so the total is about 65 g. Olives run about 115-145 kcal per 100 g, and Kalamata are on the higher side. I'll use about 1.3 kcal/g, which gives roughly 85 kcal. Some oil may be present, and there is a slight orange tint, perhaps from herbs or pepper. I'll add a little for that and round up to about 90 kcal.
